G1: TR-069 & Management.cwmp.c: Implementation of CWMP (TR-069) specification. Handles core events like bootstrap, periodic updates, and retry mechanisms for ACS communication.
G1: TR-069 & Management.http.c: HTTP client layer utilizing CURL. Manages SSL certificates, URL redirects, and robust data transfer to the ACS.
G1: TR-069 & Management.xml.c: XML parsing and generation using microxml. Defines standard and vendor-specific fault codes (9000-9005) for protocol compliance.
G1: TR-069 & Management.ubus.c: Ubus messaging daemon. Provides the interface for internal system notifications and inter-process communication within the CWMP stack.
G1: TR-069 & Management.config.c: UCI configuration handler. Maps OpenWrt style config files to internal EasyCWMP variables and manages default service states.

G2: HNI Middleware & HAL.aisbackup.c: AIS server-side configuration backup and recovery logic. Implements curl-based upload/download triggered by TR-069 or WebGUI.
G2: HNI Middleware & HAL.svcboot.c: Unified service booting sequence controller. Manages the initialization order of firmware info, port forwarding, and parental control services.
G2: HNI Middleware & HAL.hal_voice.c: VoIP service management layer. Monitors WAN status and triggers /etc/init.d/voip reload with updated IP/Protocol info (IPv4/v6).
G2: HNI Middleware & HAL.hal_pon.c: PON state retrieval logic. Parses /proc/xpon/ponInfo and manages OMCI configuration commands via omcicfgCmd.
G2: HNI Middleware & HAL.hal_wifi.c: WiFi configuration mapping for 802.11ax/be. Synchronizes bandwidth and PHY settings with SDK-specific hardware constants.
G2: HNI Middleware & HAL.hal_system.c: System health and board monitoring. Tracks CPU thermal data and retrieves board-level metadata via ubus system calls.
